paragraphs: (A Tanna of a baraita.) He is mentioned in halakhic matters in Shabbat 123a, Eruvin 71b, Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 3:3 and Sotah 1:1, and in the Mekhilta, Beshalach, parashah Shirah, chapter 1, after Rabbi Akiva’s words. In the Epistle of Rav Sherira Gaon, part 1, chapter 2, Rav Sherira wrote that he lived in the generation of Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel.
